git clone . && arch_check.py && pytest tests/architecture && validate_v81.py  # clean clone: 129 passed, validator PASS

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack> cargo test --no-fail-fast -p quansio-machine -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-server  # 1335 passed, 0 failed, default stack. New: tests/teammate_thread_race.rs, 12 rounds x 8 simultaneous callers on a teammate with no thread, real PostgreSQL: every caller succeeds, all get the same ACTIVE thread, exactly one thread row. Before the fix it failed in round 0 (8 callers, 8 different threads)
cd apps/desktop && vitest run  # run 1 of 3, dev stack up, all 68 files: 676 passed (collaboration.e2e included)
cd apps/desktop && vitest run  # run 2 of 3: 676 passed
cd apps/desktop && vitest run  # run 3 of 3: 676 passed. Three clean runs do not prove a rare flake gone; the deterministic reproduction and the mutants do

mutation checks, all KILLED, every mutant compiles, restored tree identical to the fix: no lock -> 4 threads for one teammate; a bare activate again -> the reported message 'illegal agent_thread transition: ACTIVE -> ACTIVE'; a creator that lost the race is told it failed -> 'state conflict'; look-then-create -> 8 threads
